desc: Ideation: derive O(n+m) sweep using M[i] = max lo among pairs with hi≤i, base = Σ(i - M[i]), gain for removing a unique top blocker.
Parse and normalize `conflictingPairs` into list of `(lo, hi)` with `lo = min(a,b)`, `hi = max(a,b)`. Build adjacency `ends[hi] = list of lo`.

Implement left-to-right sweep maintaining `mx1`, `mx2`, `cnt_mx1`, `base`, and `gain` dict. For i=1..n, process all `lo` in `ends[i]`, update top-two and counts, accumulate `base += i - mx1`, and if `cnt_mx1 == 1` add `gain[mx1] += mx1 - mx2`.
Validate with given examples (n=4, pairs=[[2,3],[1,4]] → 9; n=5, pairs=[[1,2],[2,5],[3,5]] → 12).
Test edge cases: n=2 with one pair; duplicate identical pairs; all pairs ending at same position; large n with many pairs.
